Natalie (finance): Heads-up — nightly billing ingest lag again. Today's ingest shows ~6h delay; alerts firing for team budgets. Seeing unallocated GPU spend in 2026-04-13 02:00-08:00 window. Anyone on infra can confirm pipeline backfill status? @Samir (eng-infra) @Luca (eng-ml)
Samir (eng-infra): Saw the alert. We had a Kafka consumer restart at 01:45 UTC. Restarted and resumed, but offsets jumped. Working on backfill. ETA 2-4h. Can you share the list of affected clusters/tags?
Natalie (finance): Thanks. Quick query I used to spot the gap:
```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(gpu_hours) as hours
FROM billing.events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-13 00:00:00' AND '2026-04-13 10:00:00'
AND tag IS NULL
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Got big NULL tag bucket for team_x and playpen. Also noticed credits not applied for preemptible refunds.
Luca (eng-ml): We're seeing retries from the model pool too; tagging function failed due to schema drift on the `tags` payload. Patch in PR #452, can roll now.
Samir (eng-infra): Rolling patch to tagging lambda in prod (v1.3.7). Triggering backfill job manually via `billing-backfill --from 2026-04-13 --to 2026-04-14 --force`.
Maya (product): Do we need to notify customers for any invoice changes? Which customers affected?
Natalie (finance): Preliminary list: team_x (internal), acme-inc (sandbox experiments), a few trial accounts. I don't think external invoices changed — it's allocation only, not total dollar amount — but need to confirm credits.
billing-bot: [alert] nightly-ingest: consumer_restart detected at 2026-04-13T01:45:10Z — offsets_resumed. Backfill job queued (job_id: bf-2145).
Samir (eng-infra): Backfill started. ETA ~90m. I'll post progress every 30m. cc @Natalie (finance)
Natalie (finance): Great — once backfill completes can you export updated allocation CSV and drop into S3 `s3://redwood-finance/allocations/2026-04-13-backfill.csv`? I will run the chargeback and update budgets. :thumbsup:
Samir (eng-infra): Will do. One ask: if preemptible refund mapping is missing, we might need manual adjustment. @Luca can you confirm PR handles refund records?
Luca (eng-ml): PR includes refund mapping; verified locally against sample. If we see any residuals I'll open a follow-up ticket.
Natalie (finance): Thanks team. If backfill slips past 4 hours, we'll throttle alerts for teams to avoid noise. Updating finance pager doc.
Samir (eng-infra): 30% done — 60k events left. ETA now ~75m.
Natalie (finance): Copy. Keep me posted.
(edited)
